source_a.citation: Schneider, J., Dedieu, C., Le Sidaner, P., Savalle, R., & Zolotukhin, I. 2011, A&A 532, A79 (The Extrasolar Planets Encyclopaedia). Kaggle dataset: Wojcikiewicz, E., Exoplanets Database (https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/eduardowoj/exoplanets-database).
source_a.column_semantics: Planet name in '# name'; planet radius in JUPITER radii (R_Jup), planet mass in JUPITER masses (M_Jup; mass_sini field excluded from true mass); orbital period in days; semi-major axis in AU; host star radius in R_sun, effective temperature in K, mass in M_sun, distance in pc, V magnitude in mag; eccentricity dimensionless. Protocol converts radius and mass to Earth units with documented factors (R_JUPITER_TO_R_EARTH=11.209, M_JUPITER_TO_M_EARTH=317.828). Detection type recorded in 'detection_type'; publication status in 'publication_status'.
source_a.derivative_status: Derivative snapshot of the Exoplanet.eu catalog distributed through Kaggle as the exoplanets-database dataset; retrieved as kepler.csv. CORRECTED-SNAPSHOT (protocol 2.4.0 forensic correction, 2026-08-14): the K2-136 d radius entry was unit-corrected from 1.450 R_Jup to 0.129360 R_Jup (=1.450 R_earth, Mann et al. 2018), with radius_error_min/max corrected from 0.08/0.11 R_Jup to 0.007137/0.009814 R_Jup (=0.080/0.110 R_earth). Only the single K2-136 d row was modified; all other rows and columns byte-identical to the raw snapshot (sha256=74b9c7ae67f0fde28ad33e5777d883f37e3eec5efc6d0f1910d123bcc89b94a4).
source_a.label: Exoplanets Database (Exoplanet.eu catalog snapshot)
source_a.license: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain / Scientific Research Use).

All other rows and columns are byte-identical to the original snapshot.

source_b.column_semantics: Planet name in 'planet_name', host star in 'host_star'; planet radius in EARTH radii (planet_radius_earth), planet mass in EARTH masses (planet_mass_earth); orbital period in days (orbital_period_days); semi-major axis in AU; host star radius in R_sun (star_radius_sun), effective temperature in K (star_temp_k), mass in M_sun (star_mass_sun), distance in pc (dist_from_earth_pc), V magnitude in mag (star_vmag); discovery method in 'discovery_method'; discovery year in 'disc_year'; engineered categorical features dist_category, star_type, orbital_period_cat, habitable_zone_flag, multi_planet_system, is_recent_discovery, controversial_flag, planet_type.
